nodes.name: Webhook - Create Product
nodes.notes:
Receives multipart/form-data with:
- Text fields: name, description, categories, brand, tags, regular_price, sale_price, sku, stock_mode, quantity, gallery_count
- Binary files: product_image, gallery_image_0, gallery_image_1, etc.

nodes.name: HTTP Request - Upload Image to WP Media
nodes.notes:
Uploads each image to WordPress Media Library.
Processes ALL items (main image + gallery images).
Each item's binary 'file' is sent to /wp/v2/media.
Returns the WordPress media object with 'id' for each.

nodes.name: Code - Collect Image IDs & Prepare Tags
HTTP Request - Create or Find Tag
nodes.notes:
Attempts to create each tag. If the tag already exists,
WooCommerce returns a 'term_exists' error with resource_id.
We handle both cases in the next Code node to extract the tag ID.

nodes.name: HTTP Request - Create WooCommerce Product
nodes.notes:
Creates the WooCommerce simple product.
The payload includes: name, type=simple, description,
prices, images (with media IDs), categories, tags, and stock config.

nodes.name: HTTP Request - Assign Brand
nodes.notes:
IMPORTANT: Replace 'BRAND_TAXONOMY' in the JSON body key with your actual brand taxonomy slug (e.g., 'product_brand').

This assigns the brand term to the product using the WordPress REST API.
The product custom post type must have the brand taxonomy registered with show_in_rest=true.

The URL uses /wp/v2/product/{id} — this is the WordPress REST API endpoint for the 'product' post type.
